rows.name: gee/gaussian-unstructured
rows.first_error:
MethodIncompatibility: gee: the estimated unstructured working correlation is not positive definite.
  -> recovery: Use corstr='independence' (still consistent, with the same robust covariance) or a simpler structure.
rows.mechanism: Known small-sample property of the sandwich with an unstructured working correlation: 45 correlations are estimated from 100 clusters, the fitted weights are noisy and the robust SE is biased down (SE/SD 0.89). In 7% of the draws the estimated correlation matrix is not positive definite and sp.gee refuses it with a typed error. The AR(1) and exchangeable rows on the same data are calibrated.
